Signed residuals between observed occurrence and predicted suitability

Source: R/spatial_bias_reduction.R
point_residuals.Rd

The residual is the difference \(y - \hat p\) on the suitability (probability) scale, so it can be kriged and added straight back onto a prediction (see apply_residual_correction). A POSITIVE residual is a site the model UNDER-rates (observed exceeds predicted).

Usage

point_residuals(points, observed, predicted, layer = 1)

Arguments

points

An sf point layer.

observed

Column name in points, or a numeric 0/1 vector, of the observed occurrence.

predicted

The predicted suitability: a terra SpatRaster (sampled at the points), a column name in points, or a numeric vector.

layer

For a raster predicted, the layer to sample (name or index; default the first).

Value

points with added columns pred and resid.
